products.title: Shunkai Hexagonal Nano Fiber Makeup Brush
products.title_zh: 顺凯六边形纳米纤维化妆刷
products.sub_title: Patented hexagonal design, imported nano bristles, powder-saving
products.sub_title_zh: 专利六边形设计，采用进口纳米纤维毛，紧密均匀不吃粉
products.descr:
Manufactured by Dongguan Shunkai Plastic Co., Ltd., this professional makeup brush features a unique patented hexagonal design. The handle is filled with sparkling gold flakes, combining aesthetics with ergonomic grip.

  • Imported nano fiber bristles for a soft touch
  • Dense and uniform bristles that do not absorb foundation or powder
  • Durable plastic handle with premium decorative elements
Patented product, samples and orders are highly welcomed.
products.descr_zh:
这款专业化妆刷由东莞市顺凯塑胶有限公司生产，采用独特的专利六边形设计。刷柄内注有闪耀的金箔/亮片，兼顾美观与符合人体工学的握持感。

  • 采用进口纳米纤维毛，触感柔软
  • 刷毛紧密、均匀，不吃粉，节省化妆品
  • 高品质塑胶刷柄，搭配精美内部装饰
顺凯专利产品，欢迎拿样与订购。

  2. IP54 dust and splash resistant

products.title: ASK-300 E-Sports Wireless Headset
products.sub_title_zh: 2.4GHz 低延迟，虚拟环绕声，RGB 灯效
products.descr:
The ASK-300 is built for competitive gaming with 2.4GHz low-latency connection and virtual surround sound.

  • 17ms ultra-low latency
  • 42mm drivers
  • Detachable noise-cancelling mic
products.descr_zh:
ASK-300 为竞技游戏而生，采用 2.4GHz 低延迟连接与虚拟环绕声。

  • 17ms 超低延迟
  • 42mm 驱动单元
  • 可拆卸降噪麦克风
